disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全量扫描源码与构建产物，未发现硬编码的密钥、口令、令牌或云凭据，未发现读取用户凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据目录的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Full scan of source code and build artifacts: no hardcoded keys, passwords, tokens, or cloud credentials found; no code paths that read user credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credential directories detected.

checked_items.zh: 交互组件中密码输入框的值不持久化、不进入表单收集；系统提示词段落明确写入「不索取密码、API Key、Token、恢复码」的禁令，无凭据收集面。
checked_items.en: In interactive components, the value of password input fields is not persisted and not collected into forms; system prompt paragraphs explicitly include a prohibition "do not ask for passwords, API keys, tokens, or recovery codes," with no credential collection surface.

checked_items.zh: 未发现钱包助记词、私钥遍历或金融签名类代码；成就系统仅存储使用事件计数与哈希指纹，绝不保存消息或界面内容。
checked_items.en: No wallet seed phrases, private key traversal, or financial signing code found; the achievement system only stores usage event counts and hash fingerprints, never saving message or UI content.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；插件节点端与浏览器端均无出站外联能力，凭据外泄链路不成立。
evidence.en: No code reading credential files or sensitive paths found; neither the plugin server-side nor the browser-side has outbound connection capability, so the credential exfiltration chain is not established.

checked_items.zh: 通读注入系统提示词的围栏语言教学段落（源码 src/plugin/index.ts:93-116）：内容为组件词汇表与使用规则，含「不索取密码/API Key/Token/恢复码」的明确禁令，无任何指令覆写、伪造系统消息或隐藏意图措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the fenced language teaching paragraph injected into the system prompt (source src/plugin/index.ts:93-116): the content is a component vocabulary table and usage rules, containing an explicit prohibition "do not ask for passwords/API keys/tokens/recovery codes," with no instruction overriding, forged system messages, or hidden intent wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查两个注册工具对模型可见的描述（render_ui 与 validate_dsh_ui，定义在 src/plugin/tool.ts:159-163 与 :210-214），均为纯功能说明，无诱导安装、诱导改配置、诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: Review the model-visible descriptions of two registered tools (render_ui and validate_dsh_ui, defined at src/plugin/tool.ts:159-163 and :210-214): both are purely functional descriptions, with no wording that induces installation, configuration changes, or credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 审查技能文档（SKILL.md）、README、CHANGELOG 与演示提示词：未发现隐藏指令、HTML 注释藏匿文本或远程指令加载文案。SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 描述为白名单组件词汇表，含秘密禁令，无注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Review the skill document (SKILL.md), README, CHANGELOG, and demo prompts: no hidden instructions, text concealed in HTML comments, or remote instruction loading text found. The frontmatter description of SKILL.md is a whitelist component vocabulary table, containing a secret prohibition, with no injection wording.

checked_items.zh: 交互动作回传机制（用户点击组件后把动作名与组件数据发回模型）是生成式 UI 的既定设计：动作名来自模型自己写出的规格，回传文案只要求模型按组件数据重新渲染，无外部指令注入面。
checked_items.en: The interactive action callback mechanism (sending the action name and component data back to the model after user clicks on a component) is a standard design of generative UI: the action name comes from the specification written by the model itself, and the callback text only asks the model to re-render based on the component data, with no external instruction injection surface.

checked_items.zh: 插件未提供上下文历史压缩引擎实现，不存在借压缩裁剪安全指令或证据的接缝（未 extends CompactionEngine）。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not provide an implementation of a context history compression engine; there is no seam for trimming security instructions or evidence via compression (does not extend CompactionEngine).

evidence.zh: 系统提示词段落与工具描述均无指令注入或隐藏意图，未见描述投毒。
evidence.en: System prompt paragraphs and tool descriptions have no instruction injection or hidden intent; no description poisoning found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与提示词段落未含诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and prompt paragraphs do not contain wording that induces execution of installation, modification of configuration, or permission escalation.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听模型推理前的消息改写事件（agent/pre-step），不存在改写或注入用户消息的接缝。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen for the message rewriting event before model inference (agent/pre-step); there is no seam for rewriting or injecting user messages.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）为极简的插件插入声明，仅插入一行 genui 插件，不含任何可执行标量，未触碰任何安全行；全树未发现配置执行载荷。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml) is a minimal plugin insertion declaration, only inserting one line for the genui plugin, containing no executable scalars, and not touching any security lines; no configuration execution payload found in the entire tree.

checked_items.zh: 插件运行时代码（节点端与浏览器端）无动态求值、无子进程调用；函数图表达式求值器为手写递归下降解析器（白名单函数表在 safe-math.ts），测试显式断言 eval、全局对象、属性访问等注入串被拒绝（tests/genui-v11.spec.tsx:32-37）。
checked_items.en: The plugin runtime code (server-side and browser-side) has no dynamic evaluation and no child process calls; the function graph expression evaluator is a hand-written recursive descent parser (whitelist function table in safe-math.ts), and tests explicitly assert that injection strings like eval, global objects, and property access are rejected (tests/genui-v11.spec.tsx:32-37).

checked_items.zh: 包发布清单无安装/构建后钩子；目录内执行载体（CI 工作流、发布脚本、打包校验脚本、视觉 E2E 脚本）经内容核查均为标准工程实践；一键安装脚本（scripts/install.sh）对 skill 同步做了符号链接安全边界处理，profile 参数校验严格（仅字母数字下划线连字符），测试覆盖这些边界（tests/install-script.spec.ts）。
checked_items.en: The package manifest has no install/postinstall hooks; the in-repository execution carriers (CI workflows, release scripts, pack verification scripts, visual E2E scripts) are all standard engineering practices after content review; the one-click install script (scripts/install.sh) handles symbolic link security boundaries for skill synchronization, and the profile parameter validation is strict (only alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen), with tests covering these boundaries (tests/install-script.spec.ts).

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端渲染防线完整：组件树深度/节点预算、字符串长度上限、颜色/链接/媒体地址协议白名单（src/client/guard.ts:113-131），ECharts 配置清洗强制 richText tooltip 过滤 HTML/脚本注入与 url() 外带（:1055-1103），mermaid 严格模式加渲染后 SVG 复查过滤脚本/事件处理/javascript: URI（src/client/mermaid-safe.ts:15-24），密码输入不持久化。
checked_items.en: Browser-side rendering defenses are complete: component tree depth/node budget, string length limit, color/link/media address protocol whitelist (src/client/guard.ts:113-131), ECharts configuration sanitization forces richText tooltip to filter HTML/script injection and url() exfiltration (:1055-1103), mermaid strict mode plus post-render SVG review to filter scripts/event handlers/javascript: URIs (src/client/mermaid-safe.ts:15-24), and password input is not persisted.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器 bundle 无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据 RPC；机械扫描命中的键盘监听（Escape 关闭弹窗）与剪贴板写入（复制按钮、模板中心复制）均为 UI 交互功能，已在源文件 src/client/blocks/advanced.tsx:217-244 与 src/client/TemplateDrawer.tsx:29-46 逐行确认；成就系统仅存储使用计数哈希指纹。
checked_items.en: The browser bundle has no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC; the keyboard listener (Escape to close popup) and clipboard write (copy button, template center copy) hit by the mechanical scan are all UI interaction functions, and have been confirmed line by line in source files src/client/blocks/advanced.tsx:217-244 and src/client/TemplateDrawer.tsx:29-46; the achievement system only stores usage count hash fingerprints.

checked_items.zh: 懒加载图表/3D 引擎从插件自己的资源路由（经宿主服务器）读取，文件名白名单防路径穿越（src/plugin/index.ts:44，ASSET_FILE_RE）。
checked_items.en: Lazy-loaded chart/3D engines are read from the plugin's own asset route (via the host server), with a filename whitelist to prevent path traversal (src/plugin/index.ts:44, ASSET_FILE_RE).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅一行 insert 插入插件声明，不含 !!js 标量或任何可执行内容；全树未发现配置执行载荷。
evidence.en: The patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml) only has one line inserting a plugin declaration, with no !!js scalar or any executable content; no configuration execution payload found in the entire tree.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具的调用（cordis_define/cordis_run），宿主半区无此类能力声明。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) found; the host half has no such capability declaration.

evidence.zh: 包发布清单无 install/preinstall/postinstall/prepare 钩子；目录内执行载体（CI 工作流 .github/workflows/*.yml、发布脚本 scripts/prepack.mjs/verify-pack.mjs、E2E 脚本 scripts/e2e.mjs/e2e-visual.mts、安装辅助脚本 scripts/install.sh）均为标准 CI/发布/测试/安装辅助流程，无外联或隐蔽下载执行。
evidence.en: The package manifest has no install/preinstall/postinstall/prepare hooks; the in-repository execution carriers (CI workflows .github/workflows/*.yml, release scripts scripts/prepack.mjs/verify-pack.mjs, E2E scripts scripts/e2e.mjs/e2e-visual.mts, install helper script scripts/install.sh) are all standard CI/release/test/install helper workflows, with no outbound connections or hidden download execution.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器半区（dsh.client），但 bundle 仅渲染白名单组件树并把交互数据回传模型，无键盘窃听、剪贴板窃取或凭证 RPC（仅含复制按钮与模板中心复制指令等 UI 功能）。
evidence.en: The browser half (dsh.client) is declared, but the bundle only renders the whitelist component tree and sends interaction data back to the model; there is no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC (only contains UI functions such as copy button and template center copy instructions).

evidence.zh: 插件未注册子代理提供方（subagents.registerProvider），仅在 skills 注册了技能提供方（registerProvider 用于 SKILL.md 分发），不存在把轮次委派给进程外 agent 产品的接缝。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register a subagent provider (subagents.registerProvider); it only registers a skill provider in skills (registerProvider for SKILL.md distribution); there is no seam for delegating turns to out-of-process agent products.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标等 dsh 原生持驻机制（未调用 jobs.start/schedule_create/goals），未监听轮次终止事件（agent/turn-stopping）。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register background tasks, timed reminders, or persistent goals, which are dsh native persistence mechanisms (no calls to jobs.start/schedule_create/goals); it does not listen for the turn-stopping event (agent/turn-stopping).

checked_items.zh: 节点端与浏览器端源码均无出站网络调用（无 fetch、XHR、WebSocket、信标发送）；懒加载引擎从宿主本机资源路由读取（/plugins/@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/assets/*），非外网。
checked_items.en: The server-side and browser-side source code has no outbound network calls (no fetch, XHR, WebSocket, beacon sending); the lazy-loading engine reads from the host's local asset route (/plugins/@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/assets/*), not from the external network.

checked_items.zh: 交互动作经会话通道回传模型用于界面更新，目标为模型上下文而非外部端点；面板指令同样只发给模型。
checked_items.en: Interactive actions are sent back to the model via the session channel for UI updates, with the target being the model context rather than an external endpoint; panel instructions are also only sent to the model.

checked_items.zh: 媒体与链接组件仅按白名单协议渲染用户可见内容；safeHref（src/client/guard.ts:126-131）拒绝非 http(s)/mailto 协议，safeMediaSrc（:136-143）拒绝 file:/data: 等本地或主动协议，ECharts 配置也过滤 url() 与脚本注入（:1069-1073），未发现隐蔽外带通道。
checked_items.en: Media and link components only render user-visible content according to the whitelist protocols; safeHref (src/client/guard.ts:126-131) rejects non-http(s)/mailto protocols, safeMediaSrc (:136-143) rejects local or active protocols like file:/data:, and ECharts configuration also filters url() and script injection (:1069-1073); no covert exfiltration channels found.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取面、无出站通道，凭据外泄链路不成立；机械扫描中一条 curl 命中（DSH-C05→DG-R4-53）实为打包产物报错文案中 curly 一词的误匹配。
evidence.en: No credential reading surface, no outbound channel; the credential exfiltration chain is not established; a curl hit in the mechanical scan (DSH-C05→DG-R4-53) is actually a false match of the word "curly" in the error message of the build artifact.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听模型请求路由事件（agent/request/agent/request-error），也未注册自定义 LLM 适配器（registerAdapter），不存在把对话重路由到未声明端点或接管错误恢复的接缝。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen for model request routing events (agent/request/agent/request-error), nor does it register a custom LLM adapter (registerAdapter); there is no seam for rerouting conversations to undeclared endpoints or taking over error recovery.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单均为官方源（React、宿主 @deepseek-ai/* SDK 系列、echarts/mermaid/three），无抢注包、无拼写相似包；版本范围为常规语义化区间。
checked_items.en: The dependency list is all from official sources (React, host @deepseek-ai/* SDK series, echarts/mermaid/three); there are no typo-squatting packages or similar-looking packages; version ranges are regular semver ranges.

checked_items.zh: 无安装钩子；发布前脚本（scripts/prepack.mjs）仅触发重建，打包校验脚本（scripts/verify-pack.mjs）检查发布完整性。一键安装辅助脚本（scripts/install.sh）使用 npm 包安装方式，非 git 浮动引用。
checked_items.en: No install hooks; the pre-release script (scripts/prepack.mjs) only triggers a rebuild, and the pack verification script (scripts/verify-pack.mjs) checks release integrity. The one-click install helper script (scripts/install.sh) uses npm package installation, not a git floating reference.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置不触碰安全行、不修改禁用开关、不注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration does not touch security lines, does not modify disable switches, and does not inject or intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 对比上一版基线报告（0.9.6）：本版新增技能自动注册（skills.registerProvider，src/plugin/index.ts:201-203）、npm 发布作用域变更和图表验证强化，均为纯插件功能增强，未新增任何能力声明或安装钩子，无能力突变。
checked_items.en: Comparing with the previous baseline report (0.9.6): this version adds automatic skill registration (skills.registerProvider, src/plugin/index.ts:201-203), npm publish scope change, and chart validation enhancements; all are pure plugin feature enhancements, with no new capability declarations or install hooks added, and no capability mutation.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 23 条静态扫描机械命中，全部逐条裁决确认为良性机制或构建产物，未发现真实风险。

evidence.en: The patch configuration only inserts the plugin line, does not override security configurations such as sandbox/approval/permissions, and has no privilege-lowering instructions.

evidence.zh: 未发现对安全事件的优先监听（prepend）或截断审批链（approval/request、tools/pre-execute）的行为。
evidence.en: No behavior of priority listening (prepend) on security events or truncating the approval chain (approval/request, tools/pre-execute) found.

evidence.zh: 与上一版（0.9.6）对比，本版 dsh 能力声明（bundle/client）未变，无升级自动激活突变。
evidence.en: Compared with the previous version (0.9.6), the dsh capability declarations (bundle/client) in this version have not changed, and there is no automatic activation mutation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置（inject/intercept），无安全插件失效式攻击面。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not modify injection/interception configurations (inject/intercept), and there is no attack surface that disables security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动网络服务或监听端口；仅在宿主服务器上注册静态资源前缀路由（/plugins/@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/assets/*，文件名白名单防路径穿越），供浏览器端懒加载引擎使用。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start its own network service or listen on any port; it only registers a static asset prefix route on the host server (/plugins/@changfenhuang/dsh-genui/assets/*, with filename whitelist to prevent path traversal), for use by the browser-side lazy-loading engine.

checked_items.zh: 本次无动态沙箱观测产物，运行时行为仅凭静态分析评估。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox observation artifacts for this version; runtime behavior is evaluated only through static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动本机服务，宿主服务器无认证风险属生态固有风险而非本插件引入；插件未注册任何 RPC 或特权方法。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start local services; the absence of authentication risk on the host server is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin; the plugin does not register any RPC or privileged methods.

- DG-R2-52 (DSH-T02): src/plugin/index.ts:169 system prompt paragraph registered as a real mechanism; the paragraph text, after semantic review, contains a secret prohibition, no injection wording.
- DG-R3-55 (DSH-X03): child_process references in scripts/e2e-visual.mts:18, scripts/e2e.mjs:24, scripts/prepack.mjs:9, scripts/verify-pack.mjs:9 are E2E testing and build infrastructure; tests/genui-v11.spec.tsx:34 is a test vector for injection rejection test (content is a string literal, not an actual call); tests/install-script.spec.ts:8 is infrastructure for install script security boundary testing.
